svg.title: Who from Biddaloy can sign in to your school
svg.desc: The school admin chooses one of three settings. Allowed lets Biddaloy support log in. Ask each time makes support ask and an admin approves or says Not now. Blocked stops all normal logins and ends anyone logged in. Emergency access always exists, needs a reason and tells the admins at once. Every login shows in a list for the last 90 days.
